name: Le Charcutier (Le Charcutier Aoun) online delivery
location_or_channel: Website + iOS/Android app; coverage list names "Amsheet, Byblos" plus Blat, Halat, Mastita, Qartaboun and ~90 other Byblos-district villages; has a Jbeil (Mastita) branch
price_of_comparable_item: Delivery fee and minimum basket not published on the site or app listing (checked); scheduled or express delivery
what_it_sells: Groceries from a 19-branch Lebanese supermarket chain delivered to the door

name: Tawfeer LB app (Tawfeer home delivery)
location_or_channel: iOS/Android app (developer Suppy); delivery areas not published; nearest store is Tawfeer MAX Jbeil (Qartaboun)
price_of_comparable_item: Delivery fee, minimum basket and areas not published; date + time slot; cash or card on delivery
what_it_sells: 2,500+ grocery items delivered 7 days a week in refrigerated cabinets

name: Toters (incl. Toters Fresh dark stores and Butler)
location_or_channel: App (Lebanon, Iraq, US); Amchit/Jbeil coverage not stated publicly - FAQ says enter your address in the app
price_of_comparable_item: Not published: "Delivery cost varies depending on the store, hour, and your location"; no minimum or subscription found in official sources
what_it_sells: On-demand delivery from 2,000+ partner stores incl. supermarkets; own dark grocery stores (Toters Fresh); Butler buys or picks up anything that fits on a bike

name: noknok
location_or_channel: App; FAQ coverage: Beirut, Baabda, Amioun, Tripoli, Zahle, Batroun, most of Keserwan and Metn - Jbeil/Amchit not named
price_of_comparable_item: $1.85 per order flat; no minimum basket
what_it_sells: Groceries plus beauty, electronics, sports, home, toys; average delivery 30 minutes

name: Spinneys Lebanon online
location_or_channel: Website + app; home delivery to Beirut, Greater Beirut and Mount Lebanon (+ Jeita, Ajaltoun, Achkout, Feitroun, Faraya); fulfilment stores Hazmieh, Elissar, Ajaltoun; Jbeil/Amchit not named
price_of_comparable_item: Minimum order $30; delivery fee not published
what_it_sells: 9,000+ items; delivery 7 days a week; refrigerated trucks; click and collect at Hazmieh
positioning_line: Deliver to Beirut, Greater Beirut and Mount Lebanon

name: Carrefour Lebanon online (Majid Al Futtaim)
location_or_channel: Website + app; Scheduled and Express delivery; area selector; Amchit coverage unverified (site returned HTTP 503 to our reader)
price_of_comparable_item: 130,000 LBP (about $1.45 at 89,700 LBP/$) delivery fee shown on product pages for Hazmieh - Baabda; minimum not found

name: InstaShop (Talabat)
location_or_channel: App marketplace; listed as operating in Lebanon (Wamda, 6 Mar 2025); Jbeil coverage, fee and minimum not found
what_it_sells: Marketplace that connects users with grocery and retail vendors

name: AntounGreens
location_or_channel: Small farm in Rasmaska; WhatsApp orders; listing says Tuesday home delivery for Batroun, Byblos and parts of Beirut (site could not be reached 2026-11-17; facts from search-result text only)
price_of_comparable_item: Fee not found; order before 6 PM for next day; cash on delivery
what_it_sells: Farm produce delivered on set days

name: Tawfeer MAX Jbeil (in-store)
location_or_channel: 2,000 m2 store in Qartaboun on the Beirut-Jbeil highway; opened 21-22 May 2026; trade area Jounieh-Jbeil-Batroun
price_of_comparable_item: No fee (in-store); three volume tiers: lowest single-unit price, lower price for larger quantities, wholesale price for small shops/restaurants/cafes
what_it_sells: 5,500 SKUs; no membership, no expiring promos; tier 3 is B2B wholesale

name: Spinneys Jbeil (in-store)
location_or_channel: Store in Jbeil (one of 10 Spinneys outlets in Lebanon)
price_of_comparable_item: No fee (in-store); shelf prices not compared here
what_it_sells: Full supermarket incl. fresh meat, fish, produce, bakery

name: Le Charcutier Aoun Jbeil - Mastita (in-store)
location_or_channel: Store in Jbeil (Mastita); directory page last updated July 2021

name: Village dekkene / mini-markets inside Amchit and neighbouring villages
location_or_channel: Walking distance in each village; orders by phone/WhatsApp common in Lebanon (founder brief)
price_of_comparable_item: No fee; founder says prices are higher than city supermarkets - no public price data found

name: Via Appia weekly market, Byblos old town
location_or_channel: Square near the Crusader Castle, Byblos; Saturdays 4-10 pm per 2018 report; 2025-26 status not confirmed
price_of_comparable_item: No fee; producer prices not published
what_it_sells: Fruit, vegetables, bread, dairy, honey, pickles, crafts from local producers

name: Drive down to the Jbeil supermarkets (weekly/monthly)
location_or_channel: Own car; Amchit is about 3.5 km from Byblos port (hotel listing); Tawfeer MAX, Spinneys and Le Charcutier are on or near the Jbeil highway
price_of_comparable_item: Fuel 2,837,000 LBP (about $31.63) per jerrycan of 95-octane on 2 Oct 2026, plus time and parking
what_it_sells: Full choice; tier prices if the household buys in bulk

name: Ask a commuting relative or neighbour
location_or_channel: Informal; anyone driving to Jbeil or Beirut

name: Monthly bulk shop
location_or_channel: Own car to Tawfeer MAX or another hypermarket
price_of_comparable_item: No fee; Tawfeer MAX pricing is "cheap by the piece, cheaper by quantity, and cheapest by the carton"
what_it_sells: Stock-up of dry goods and cleaning products
